_comment: Machine-readable trunk/branch map for compose_trunk_report.py. Human version: kinetic_chain_trunk.md. Rules: only branches listed here may appear at top level; every leaf has a role; status rules are fixed here, not in the script. Changing this file requires user approval and a note in kinetic_chain_trunk.md.

trunk.zh: 动力链：力从地面经腿、髋扭转、躯干传到手臂和拍子，并在对的时间启动

status_rules.has_facts: at least one leaf with role=evidence matched by an input fact with source in [model, pose, manual] and agree >= 2/3 and value != unclear
status_rules.pending_self_report: no qualifying fact, but at least one self_report mapped to this branch
status_rules.pending_untested: no qualifying fact and no self_report
status_rules.rule: a branch is NEVER dropped from the report; it is shown with one of the three statuses

branches.zh: 粗枝 1：髋没把力传上来 → 手臂 / 小臂代偿

leaves.zh: 准备时上身转了一点，但不是坐进后髋的扭
leaves.note: NEW candidate, not in catalog; may be shown but never counts toward has_facts

leaves.zh: 触球时髋线已朝网（开放站位下不等于扭转后转回，要结合 OBS-25 读）
蹬髋只是象征性：身体往前移、力不往上传（C 层为主）
脚钉死 / 宽开放站位钉在原地
膝盖没有深弯（正后方看不准深浅）
臂和胸是否同步（正后方实测看不清）
躯干是否减速（实测看不清）
骨盆是否减速（实测看不清）

excluded_siblings.zh: 准备阶段转肩一体化引拍 OK → 削弱「准备不足」一支
横向间距 OK、没被挤住 → 削弱「被挤住」一支

branches.zh: 粗枝 2：挥拍启动过早（击球点与时机）

leaves.zh: 前挥启动时球还在弹起 / 未到最高点
开始转体时拍头还在球上方
触球点在身体前后（与启动时机是两个量）

missing_facts_if_pending.question: At the moment the forward swing starts, is the incoming ball still rising after the bounce, at about its highest point, or already descending?

branch_links.zh: 急着挥 → 髋没扭起来手臂就抢先（推断，不是证据）

next_one_thing.zh: 等球过了最高点、开始往下落，再启动前挥。
next_one_thing.breath: 准备时鼻吸，启动前挥至触球时用嘴短促呼气。
next_one_thing.protocol: 发球机最低速 40 球：10 基线 + 2×10 目标 + 10 复测，每球口播结果
